info.title: KF Inventory API
info.description: The JSON API behind the React UI.

put.summary:
QuickPhraseOrderInput: the phrases' new order (these ids first, the others after them) → every phrase. 404
quick_phrase_not_found for an id that is not a phrase.

post.summary:
{"username", "password", "remember_me"?}: the session starts and the answer is who signed in. 401
invalid_credentials for a wrong username or password.
Ends the session: 204.

get.summary: Who is signed in. 401 when nobody is.

A page of users, by name: the list contract (q over name, username and email; filters name, username, email,
roles[] — the nine assignable —, enabled[] yes/no; sorts name, username, email).

post.summary: UserInput: creates a user. The password is required. 422 when invalid.

get.summary: One user. 404 user_not_found.

put.summary: UserInput: edits a user; a blank password keeps the current one. 404 user_not_found, 422 when invalid.

get.summary: A product by its code (the barcode reader). 404 product_not_found.
A product by uuid. 404 product_not_found.

post.summary: ProductInput: creates a product (no stock until some is uploaded, scanned or moved).

multipart: `file` (xls/xlsx, the template's columns) and `warehouse_id`: the products are created or updated and
their quantities added to the warehouse's stock. 404 warehouse_not_found; 415 unsupported_media; 422
invalid_spreadsheet.

get.summary:
The stock spreadsheet (an xls attachment): `all=1` for every product, or `uuid[]=…` for the selected ones; with
neither, the header alone.

A page of the warehouse's stock rows with `status` (1 in stock, default; 0 incoming): the list contract (q over
code, title and detail; filters code, title, detail, quantity, price, in_stock; sorts code, title, quantity,
price; `per_page=0` every row, for the pickers) and `totals` (units, value) over every row the filters keep.

post.summary:
StockLinesInput: moves quantities to another warehouse (they arrive as incoming). 204; 409 same_warehouse;
404 product_not_found, stock_not_found, warehouse_not_found; 422 insufficient_stock (detail: code, available).
StockLinesInput (by code): the barcode reader adds stock; an unknown code is skipped. 204.

StockLinesInput (by code): the barcode reader removes stock; an unknown code is skipped. 204; 404 stock_not_found;
422 insufficient_stock (detail: code, available).
Approves every incoming row of the warehouse. 404 warehouse_not_found.

get.summary: Every warehouse, by id (as /admin/warehouse/all: any signed-in user).

put.summary: WarehouseInput: renames a warehouse (as the legacy edit: any signed-in user). 404 warehouse_not_found.

get.summary:
A page of customers, newest first: the list contract (q over first/last name, email, phone and city; filters
name, email, phone, city, country[] (country ids, any address); sorts name, email, city).

post.summary:
CustomerInput: creates a customer, or, as the legacy form did, updates the one the id, else the email, else the
phone names. 422 without a first name or an email.

get.summary:
Every customer, for the order and invoice pickers (those without an address too). Whoever the legacy order and
invoice forms embedded the list for reads it: ROLE_MANAGE_CUSTOMERS, ROLE_CAN_CREATE_ORDERS,
ROLE_CAN_UPDATE_ORDERS or ROLE_CAN_CREATE_INVOICES.
One customer. 404 customer_not_found.

put.summary: CustomerInput: edits a customer and replaces their addresses. 404 customer_not_found.

delete.summary: Deletes a customer (soft delete, as before), and with them their orders. 204; 404 customer_not_found.

get.summary: Every country with its states and their cities, all of them, by id.

The order's comments, oldest first (on the same date, in the order they were written); a legacy comment
without a date carries the order's (`approximate`); shop notes (`origin` shop) name their shop and no author.

put.summary:
OrderCommentsInput: the order's comments as they should be: no id adds one (signed by you), an id edits it, a
comment left out leaves the order. As before: any signed-in user.

post.summary: AddOrderCommentInput → 201 the comment (signed by you, dated now; `origin` phrase with an active `phrase_id`).
post.description:
422 shop_note_unavailable when `send_to_shop` cannot be done (the order is not from a connection, or the
connection is inactive or its order_note capability is off): nothing is written. 404 order_not_found,
quick_phrase_not_found.

post.summary:
Pins the comment (the order's only pinned one: the previous one is unpinned). 404 order_not_found,
comment_not_found (also for another order's comment).

delete.summary: Unpins it (a comment that is not pinned is left as it is). 404 order_not_found, comment_not_found.

get.summary:
`warehouse_id` (required): a page of that warehouse's orders, newest first — the list contract (q over code,
customer name and email; filters code, customer, status[] 1–6, source[] phone|web|shop:<id>, created_at,
pinned[] 1; sorts code, customer, status, created_at; facets of status and source).

post.summary:
OrderInput: places an order (the customer is found by id, email or phone and updated, or created); the printer
gets its email. 422 order_without_products; 404 product_not_found, warehouse_not_found.

get.summary: One order with its customer (and addresses), comments and products. 404 order_not_found.

put.summary: OrderInput: edits an order (its comments are not touched: PUT …/comments). 404 order_not_found.

delete.summary: Deletes an order: its product lines and comments, then the order (soft delete: it is not found any more). 204.

post.summary: OrderStatusInput: moves the order to another status (a status history row; stock is not touched).

Pulls the orders the WooCommerce shops have waiting (REST API) and places the ones the app does not have yet,
as the webhook would: `imported` placed, `skipped` already imported (deleted ones included) or not placeable
(logged). A warehouse whose shop the app holds no keys for is not pulled. 502 order_sync_failed when a shop
cannot be read (nothing is kept).

get.summary: The order as a PDF (the printer's).
What is left to ship, as a PDF.

The order's products as a spreadsheet (date, product code, quantity). As before: any signed-in user, and the
file is named after product.xls.filename and the order code.

The order's code and lines, what was shipped, what is left, and the warehouse's stock of the order's products:
all the getting-ready screen shows. As before: any signed-in user.

post.summary:
PartialInput: ships these products now. Exactly the whole order, in stock: the order is sent (status 5);
otherwise a partial shipment (status 4). Either way the products leave the order's warehouse. 409
partial_exceeds_order (more than what is left, or the order is already sent); 422 insufficient_stock (the
warehouse holds fewer); 404 stock_not_found (the warehouse has none of a product at all).

get.summary: Every connection by name, with its health.

post.summary:
ShopConnectionInput → 201 with `webhook_secret` (once) and `webhook_url`. 409 shop_url_taken, shop_name_taken;
404 warehouse_not_found; 422 shop_url_invalid (not https, a private host).

get.summary: One connection. 404 shop_not_found.

put.summary: ShopConnectionInput: blank consumer_key/consumer_secret keep the saved ones. 404 shop_not_found.

delete.summary: 204; 409 shop_has_orders when orders came from it (deactivate it instead).

get.summary: The webhook URL and signing secret to paste in WooCommerce (the consumer secret is never readable).

post.summary: Rotates the signing secret → the new one, to paste.
ShopTestInput (the keys as typed, else the saved ones): "Test connection", 15 s, never an error status.

get.summary: A page of the connection's inbox (`?status=failed`; the list contract).
One inbox row with its body. 404 delivery_not_found.

post.summary: Runs the import again from the stored body: `placed` with its order, or still `failed` with the new reason.
Marks the row discarded.

get.summary: The connection's writes in a status (`?status=failed`).

post.summary: Queues a failed write again → pending.

get.summary:
The active phrases in order. `?all=1`: every one, the hidden too (an admin's; anyone else still gets the active
ones).

post.summary: QuickPhraseInput: a phrase at the end → 201.

put.summary: QuickPhraseInput: renames it or switches it off. 404 quick_phrase_not_found.

get.summary: The analytics IDs every signed-in page loads (null: that tool is off). Any signed-in user.

Settings › Email: the SMTP server (never its password: `has_password`), the sender, the printer and the cc, each
with where the effective value comes from (settings, env, none).

put.summary:
EmailSettingsInput: saves Settings › Email (a blank password keeps the saved one; everything empty clears it, the
env applies) → EmailSettingsOutput; 422 on a bad address or a host that is not a host name alone. A blank
password is kept only while the host stays the same.

post.summary:
TestEmailInput: sends "KF Inventory test email" to `to` through the effective server, at once (not queued) →
202 with the host it went through; 502 smtp_failed with the server's message in detail.reason; 429
test_email_too_soon more than once in 10 s; 422 on from_address when no sender is set anywhere.

get.summary: Settings › Analytics: the GA4 Measurement ID and the Clarity Project ID (null: that tool is off).

put.summary: AnalyticsSettingsInput: G-XXXXXXX and the Clarity Project ID (empty turns one off); 422 on a wrong shape.

get.summary: The legacy webhook URL's switch (on until turned off: Decisions 8) and the hits it took since it was turned off.

put.summary: WebhookSettingsInput: turns the legacy webhook URL off (410 from then on; its counter starts at 0) or on.

get.summary:
A page of invoices, newest first: the list contract (q over code, customer name and email; filters code,
customer, payment_method[], created_at, total, walk_in[] yes/no; sorts code, customer, created_at, total).

post.summary:
InvoiceInput: creates an invoice (the customer is `customer_id`, or found by id, email or phone and updated, or
created from `customer`; with no address typed, the customer's first one is copied). 409 invoice_code_taken.

get.summary: The code the next invoice is offered: the newest invoice's code plus one, or the year and 0001 for the first.
One invoice. 404 invoice_not_found.
The invoice as a PDF. 404 invoice_not_found.

roles.title: The roles assigned (not the ones reached through the hierarchy)

status.title: 1: in stock; 0: incoming, waiting for approval

value.title: The sum of quantity × price, in dollars

urls.title: The X-WC-Webhook-Source values that send orders here

address_type.title: 1: billing; 2: shipping (as the WooCommerce webhook stores them)

created_at.title: ISO 8601; a legacy comment without a date carries the order's, with `approximate`

approximate.title: true when created_at is the order's date, not the comment's

author.title: null for a shop note, or a legacy comment without a user

origin.title: app (typed here), shop (a note pulled from the shop), phrase (a quick phrase)

shop.title: the connection a shop note came from

sent_to_shop.title: the comment was also sent to the order's shop as an order note

created_at.title: ISO 8601; the order's date when the comment has none (legacy rows)

status.title: 1 created, 2 processed, 3 completed, 4 partial, 5 sent, 6 delivered

shop.title: The shop connection the order came from (shop_order_link); null for orders typed here or imported before connections
The shop connection the order came from (shop_order_link); null for orders typed here or imported before connections

skipped.title: Already imported (deleted ones included), or not placeable (unknown SKU, no lines)

error.title: Why the shop could not be read; null when it was

failed.title: Connections that could not be read

order_status.title: Processed → processing, Sent and Delivered → completed

order_note.title: Comments marked "also send to the shop"

failed_pushes.title: Writes to the shop that failed every retry

webhook_url.title: The connection's own webhook URL, to paste in WooCommerce

webhook_secret.title: Only in the answer that created the connection

can_write.title: null: unknown until a write succeeded (a read cannot prove write access)

error.title: The shop's message when it failed (never the keys)

reason_code.title: bad_signature, unknown_product, no_warehouse, not_an_order, no_lines, duplicate, inactive

payload.title: The raw JSON body; null for a refused signature

host.title: The SMTP host it went through

ga4_measurement_id.title: G-XXXXXXX, from GA4 › Admin › Data streams
